rc.work_identified: Joris van Spilbergen's Journael (Delft, 1605). It covers his 1601–1604 East Indies voyage to Ceylon for de Moucheron. It is NOT the 1614–17 round-the-world voyage, which is the subject of the Oost ende West-Indische Spiegel (1619) and the 1906 Hakluyt translation.

rc.work_identified: Oldenbarnevelt's Remonstrantie to the States of Holland and West-Friesland (1618, Dutch). The English version, 'Barnevels apology', was made from the Latin translation 'Mysteria Hollandica' by Petrus Holderus. That makes it a translation via a third language (Latin) of the same underlying work.
